reason: Correcting my own error from window Q-0032-fcc8: I installed recharts from the host with npm's default caret range, writing frontend/package.json 'recharts': '^3.10.1', which violates the repo's exact-pin rule enforced at tools/quality-gate.test.mjs:319 and fails verify. Bounded to re-pinning that one dependency: frontend/package.json and package-lock.json only.
